en.title: Bill Nighy, Hayley Atwell, Maisie Williams Roar into Animated 'The Last Dino'
en.summary: A star-studded voice cast, including Bill Nighy, Hayley Atwell, and Maisie Williams, is set to bring 'The Last Dino' to life. This CG-animated family feature promises an epic adventure across time.
en.body:
Get ready for a prehistoric adventure with a touch of time-traveling magic! The upcoming CG-animated family feature, **'The Last Dino,'** has just announced an absolutely stellar English-language voice cast, led by none other than **Bill Nighy**, **Hayley Atwell**, and **Maisie Williams**. This exciting project, directed by **Federico Milella**, is poised to capture the imaginations of audiences worldwide.

Fans of **Bill Nighy** will be thrilled to hear his distinctive voice lending itself to this animated tale, following his recent acclaimed performance in **'Living.'** **Hayley Atwell**, known for her iconic role as Peggy Carter in the Marvel Cinematic Universe and her daring stunts in the **'Mission: Impossible'** franchise, brings her considerable talent to the project. And **Maisie Williams**, forever beloved as Arya Stark in **'Game of Thrones,'** adds another layer of star power. The ensemble also features notable voices such as **Stewart Clarke**, **Mike McShane**, **Joseph Balderrama**, **Joshua Rubin**, and **Cory English**, promising a rich and engaging auditory experience.

The film's synopsis hints at a grand quest: Rex, the son of the dinosaur king, is unexpectedly transported to the 21st century via a time machine. To find his way back to his own era, 65 million years in the past, he must team up with an unlikely group of companions. This premise sets the stage for a story filled with humor, heart, and perhaps a few close encounters with the modern world.

## A Dino-Sized Dream Cast

The announcement of **Bill Nighy**, **Hayley Atwell**, and **Maisie Williams** leading the charge for **'The Last Dino'** is a major coup for the animated feature. Their combined star power and proven vocal talents suggest a film that aims for both critical acclaim and broad family appeal. The film is being produced by **Fabien Westerhoff**, with **Federico Milella** and **Ben Smith** at the helm as directors. The production is leveraging CG animation, a technique that allows for visually stunning and dynamic storytelling, perfect for bringing dinosaurs and time-traveling escapades to life.

## What This Means for Dino Fans

For fans of animation, dinosaurs, and compelling voice performances, **'The Last Dino'** is shaping up to be a must-watch. The combination of a classic adventure narrative with a high-profile cast creates significant anticipation. The film is slated for a 2026 release, giving audiences plenty of time to prepare for Rex's epic journey. The involvement of such acclaimed actors signals a commitment to quality storytelling and character development, aiming to resonate with both younger viewers and the adults who grew up with tales of prehistoric giants and fantastical journeys.

## What's Next

**'The Last Dino'** is set to make its market premiere at the American Film Market next week, offering a first look to industry professionals. While a specific release date in November 2026 is indicated, further details regarding trailers, distribution, and specific plot points will likely emerge following this key industry event.
